# Synthetic workflow definition

1. Admit explicitly supplied order records.
2. Normalize a supplied amount into a display value.
3. Present a small report shape.

The TypeScript imports describe dependencies. They do not prove invocation order, timing, data transfer, health or deployment.
Source references: [input](../src/input/index.ts), [normalization](../src/normalize/index.ts), [report](../src/report/index.ts).
The missing runtime receipt is an evidence gap, not a failed production system.
